component.name: PlayerScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.msg = m.top.findNode("msg") m.video.observeField("state", "onState") m.video.observeField("position", "onPos") m.tick = 0 m.triedTs = false end sub
sub refocus() m.video.setFocus(true) end sub
function FmtOf(ext as String) as String if ext = "mkv" then return "mkv" if ext = "ts" then return "ts" if ext = "m3u8" then return "hls" return "mp4" end function
sub onInfo() m.triedTs = false startVideo(false) end sub
sub startVideo(useTs as Boolean) i = m.top.info c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") c.title = i.title if i.kind = "live" if useTs c.url = StreamUrl("live", i.sid, "ts") c.streamFormat = "ts" else c.url = StreamUrl("live", i.sid, "m3u8") c.streamFormat = "hls" end if c.live = true else folder = "movie" if i.kind = "ep" then folder = "series" ext = LCase(i.ext) if ext = "" then ext = "mp4" c.url = StreamUrl(folder, i.sid, ext) c.streamFormat = FmtOf(ext) if i.pos > 10 then c.PlayStart = i.pos end if m.video.content = c m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) m.msg.text = "Carregando..." end sub
sub onState() s = m.video.state if s = "playing" m.msg.text = "" else if s = "error" i = m.top.info if i.kind = "live" and not m.triedTs m.triedTs = true startVideo(true) return end if m.msg.text = "Não foi possível reproduzir. Aperte voltar." else if s = "finished" saveProgress(true) m.top.finished = true end if end sub
sub onPos() i = m.top.info if i = invalid then return if i.kind = "live" then return m.tick = m.tick + 1 if m.tick mod 15 = 0 then saveProgress(false) end sub
sub saveProgress(done as Boolean) i = m.top.info if i = invalid then return if i.kind = "live" then return pos = Int(m.video.position) dur = Int(m.video.duration) if pos < 10 and not done then return key = i.key if key = "" if i.kind = "ep" key = "e" + i.sid else key = "m" + i.sid end if end if finished = done if dur > 0 and pos > dur * 0.95 then finished = true if i.kind = "movie" and finished RemoveProgress(key) return end if now = CreateObject("roDateTime").AsSeconds() item = { key: key, k: i.kind, id: i.sid, ext: i.ext, title: i.title, cover: i.cover, pos: pos, dur: dur, t: now, series: i.series, season: i.season, epnum: i.epnum, done: false } if i.kind = "ep" and finished item.done = true item.pos = 0 end if SaveProgressItem(item) end sub
sub onClosing() if m.top.closing saveProgress(false) m.video.control = "stop" end if end sub
